body_lead: Kerala plans AI-backed disaster system tailored to sudden weather shifts The Kerala government will launch an AI-backed disaster management programme with advanced forecasting and flood mapping. The plan also links dam desilting, river audits and encroachment checks to stronger flood preparedness. Kerala Chief Minister VD Satheesan on Wednesday said the state would roll out an AI-backed disaster management and resilience programme, which he said would be among the country’s most effective.
